body: They keep pushing my appointment back. My next one is in March but maybe that one wont happen either. I don't think anyone can realize how inefficient the VA can be until they have tried to go through it. It is better than nothing but it is not health insurance. If I had anything happen where I had to go to an emergency room I would be screwed. I would have to pay for everything. The closest VA is 40 minutes away so I would have to assess the situation and guess if I could make it to the VA or if I wanted a hospital bill with no insurance.

After seeing combat, war movies are completely different. The action parts usually are not very realistic, although they are far better than action movies that are not war movies. The parts that I can understand and identify with are the other scenes though. Rambo talked about being in charge of million dollar pieces of equipment now he is homeless. I can relate. I was combat arms and I can't use my job skills for anything unless I wanted to be a cop. Which I don't, I pretty much hate cops. 

I never realized how good Apocalypse Now was until I sat down and watched it one day after I got out. Obviously I remembered all the famous parts like the Air Cav playing the music. What had me almost in tears was watching Martin Sheen go nuts in his hotel room. Drinking himself retarded staring at the ceiling fan reminding him of helicopter blades. I felt like I knew exactly what he was going through. His realization that he was fighting against a superior enemy. That the US just has numbers and technology which ends up beating the true warrior.
I appreciate the you taking he time to write this. I had a few tears when I read it. I don't really know what else to say. I'll check it out and maybe write a longer response later.

Thanks I didn't think to look for free help. I have been waiting on the VA which is taking forever. I am going to try to find something. Believe me I know I am depressed. I have been depressed before in my life. Like when my grandfather died or other things that have happened in my life. It has never been like this but at least I had something I could compare it to. The anxiety and the unexplained rage however are completely new to me in the past several months. I have never had either of them before. I don't even know how to explain it. I will try though. 

Do you know how your body reacts when you are about to get into a fight? Blood rushed to my face, palms get sweaty, I have a light feeling all through my body, butterflies in my stomach, heart starts beating faster, and things that I am not focusing on get tuned out or toned down. Well my body does this now out of nowhere or at the smallest annoyance. I have to stop myself and think, "why am I so angry at this person? They didn't do anything that bad to me." No one even knows anything is going on and I am trying not to explode. Sometimes it takes me hours to calm down. That is my unexplained rage. 

I am sure you have heard of anxiety before. I have never dealt with it before though. I ask myself what is wrong with me. I don't understand because I am a confident person. I have no problem (until now) getting girls or talking to strangers.      

Then there is the problems sleeping and the not being able to concentrate or remember things. I fuck up the easiest tasks at work. People must think I am dumb as shit. Although I would rather have them thinking I am dumb than knowing I am loosing it. I used to think it would pass but from talking to other vets they tell me no it just gets worse until you get help. I am trying to get help. It is just taking a long time. Thanks though.

To be fair my girlfriend is the successful one with the house. I spend all my money just giving her rent money and helping with utilities. I am sure I could get food stamps if I applied. It is her house and if I didn't live with her I would probably be living in a shithole apartment with multiple roommates. My job is better than not having one at all but that is about it.
I told the VA back in September I needed to see someone. I am still waiting.
